notes:
New in 0.1.3.9 - tsunami step 3 (breaking):
- New wave shape: the bore, a steep wall of water with a flood behind it. That is what a real tsunami has become after crossing kilometres of shallow sea, so it is how it arrives at the last stretch of coast we show.
- New scene 7 (key 7): reef shelf. A shallow shelf in front of the beach: the bore breaks, foams and floods the land.
- New programs (W): 'Bore: a wall of water, the sea pulls back first'; the level program's biggest wave is now a bore.
- Spray now has air drag: thrown water arcs and falls instead of flying across the level.
- Whitewater: water that is hit hard (bore fronts, crashes) turns white the same way in Normal and Performance mode.
- The wave maker sits 4 m further off-screen: no more notch and splash at the right edge of the screen.
- Scene 6 (steep beach): waves surge up without breaking. That is correct physics for steep coasts.

From 0.1.3.8: wave programs (W), drawback, sea level bug fixed.
